mount: apps/web/src/lib/branding-helpers.tsx
// Definitions can also sit as members of an object: the name is what counts, not the keyword.
export const brandingHelpers = {
  logoPlateFor: (luminance: number): 'none' | 'light' | 'dark' => (luminance < 0.2 ? 'light' : 'none'),
  shortOrgName(name: string): string {
    return name.slice(0, 12);
  },
};
